name: TextEffectFormat
description: Contains properties and methods that apply to WordArt objects.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

With myDocument.Shapes(1).TextEffect

    .FontName = "Courier New"

    .FontBold = True

    .FontItalic = True

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment for the specified WordArt. Read/write.

properties.name: FontBold
properties.description: Determines whether the font in the specified WordArt is bold. Read/write.

properties.name: FontItalic
properties.description: Determines whether the font in the specified WordArt is italic. Read/write.

properties.name: FontName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the font in the specified WordArt. Read/write.

properties.name: FontSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the font size for the specified WordArt in points. Read/write.

properties.name: KernedPairs
properties.description: Determines whether the character pairs in the specified WordArt are kerned. Read/write.

properties.name: NormalizedHeight
properties.description: Determines whether the characters (both uppercase and lowercase) in the specified WordArt are the same height. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetShape
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape of the specified WordArt. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetTextEffect
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the specified WordArt. Read/write.

properties.name: RotatedChars
properties.description: Determines whether characters in the specified WordArt are rotated 90 degrees relative to the WordArt's bounding shape. Read/write.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the text contained in the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: Tracking
properties.description: Returns or sets the ratio of the horizontal space allotted to each character in the specified text to the width of the character. Read/write.

methods.name: ToggleVerticalText
methods.description: Switches the text flow in the specified WordArt from horizontal to vertical, or vice versa.
